question: Can a non-fitted finite-onset diagnostic grid for the completed-U1 DAE be defined entirely from already-certified dimensionless margins and the common support of the parameter-free production source histories?

ir_gravity_truncation.meaning: strict two-spatial-derivative IR truncation; gamma2,gamma3,beta7 and other higher-spatial UV coefficients remain unfrozen rather than being physically set to zero

history_onset_rule.a_on: max over the nine C10.24 exported-history a_min values
history_onset_rule.meaning: earliest scale factor shared by every exported k history; diagnostic common-support onset, not a proof of the fundamental EFT cutoff

filter_grid.guard: all exported k<=k_ref then obey a1_eff(a_on,k)<=u and become more strongly filtered for later a

lambda_grid.meaning: diagnostic near-GR grid tied to the existing 1-percent completion-design scale, not an observational bound or fit

unselected_guards.eta0: not numerically selected; each physical-history replay must report eta0_min=3(3 lambda_HL-1)H_EFT^2/(64 M_c^2) required by the conservative history bound
unselected_guards.local_upper_window: k_local is not numerically frozen here; do not call a grid point a globally certified completion point until M_c^2<=k_local^2/99 and the isolated rank-root buffer are checked
unselected_guards.UV_coefficients: higher-spatial coefficients remain a later sensitivity gate

acceptance: derive a_on and k_ref from the persisted C10.24 result rather than hard-coding a preferred epoch or dimensional M_c
generate exactly 3x3 diagnostic (u,delta_H) points from the frozen cap fractions
verify every lambda_HL>1 and every M_c>0
verify a1_eff(a_on,k_ref) round-trips to u and is <=1/100
verify the full exported k set is no less strongly filtered at a_on and later times
record all unresolved eta0/local/UV guards explicitly
do not score spectra, likelihoods, or call any grid point a selected physical parameter point
next_if_pass: run a preregistered finite-onset memory-loss test on production RTK background histories across all nine grid points, first in the reduced dual-interface system and then in the full photon+baryon+UR hierarchy
